tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Opens a binary file with radare2 for analysis <think>Call this tool before any other one from r2mcp. Use an absolute file_path</think>

file_path.description: Path to the file to open

baddr.description: Optional base address for PIE binaries, same as radare2 -B / -m (for example 0x400000). For raw/headerless files (no ELF/PE magic), this now also creates an explicit io map so the file's content actually appears at this address, matching radare2 CLI's -m behavior

arch.description: Optional asm.arch override (eg. 'arm'), same as radare2 -a. Needed for raw/headerless binaries which cannot be autodetected and would otherwise default to the host arch

bits.description: Optional asm.bits override (eg. 16 for ARM Thumb), same as radare2 -b

cpu.description: Optional asm.cpu override (eg. 'cortex'), same as radare2 -k/-e asm.cpu

tools.name: sql
tools.description: Runs one SQL statement through a loaded SQL core plugin such as r2xsql; supports reads and writes

query.description: SQL statement to pass to the loaded SQL core plugin (r2xsql)

tools.name: close_file
tools.description: Close the currently open file

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: Lists all functions discovered during analysis

only_named.description: If true, only list functions with named symbols (excludes functions with numeric suffixes like sym.func.1000016c8)

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

max_length.description: Maximum number of results to return, -1 for all (default: 50)

tools.name: list_functions_tree
tools.description: Lists functions and successors (aflmu)

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: Lists all shared libraries linked to the binary

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

tools.name: list_imports
tools.description: Lists imported symbols (note: use list_symbols for addresses with sym.imp. prefix)

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

tools.description: Displays detailed information about the current function

tools.description: Shows the current position and function name

tools.name: show_info
tools.description: Displays information about the binary or target process

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

tools.description: Shows all available decompiler backends

tools.description: Renames the function at the specified address

address.description: Address of the function to rename

tools.description: Sets the function signature (return type, name, arguments)

tools.description: Adds a comment at the specified address

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Runs binary analysis with optional depth level

level.description: Analysis level (0-4, higher is more thorough)

timeout_seconds.description: Optional maximum analysis time in seconds for this call only. Use 0 to disable the timeout.

tools.name: xrefs_to
tools.description: Finds all code references to the specified address

tools.description: Show C-like pseudocode of the function in the given address. <think>Use this to inspect the code in a function, do not run multiple times in the same offset</think>

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Lists files in the specified path using radare2's ls -q command. Files ending with / are directories, otherwise they are files.

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

tools.description: Shows assembly listing of the function at the specified address

tools.name: disassemble
tools.description: Disassembles a specific number of instructions from an address <think>Use this tool to inspect a portion of memory as code without depending on function analysis boundaries. Use this tool when functions are large and you are only interested on few instructions</think>

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluate a math expression using core->num (r_num_math). Usecases: do proper 64-bit math, resolve addresses for flag names/symbols, and avoid hallucinated results.

tools.description: Get the process ID of the target process

tools.description: List all threads in the target process with their IDs and state

tools.description: Show register values for the target process threads

tools.description: Search for strings, hex patterns, wide strings, or numeric values

query.description: The search query (string, hex bytes, or numeric value)

type.description: Search type: string (default), hex, wide, or value

value_size.description: For value search: byte width 1, 2, 4 (default), or 8

tools.description: Resolve an export name to its implementation address
